provenance.work: Miners of the Red Mountain: Indian Labor in Potosi, 1545-1650
provenance.author: Peter Bakewell
provenance.route: User-supplied page images; visually checked. Images are not included in the repository.
provenance.period_limit: Early seventeenth century; not a direct price calibration for 1575.

mass_purchasing_power.rounding: to nearest pound, as described by the source
mass_purchasing_power.spending_rule: Entire five-day weekly mita cash wage spent on one food alone; columns are alternatives, not a basket.

daily_energy_purchasing_power.quantity_unit: kcal per day over a seven-day consumption week
daily_energy_purchasing_power.status: Bakewell reconstruction from sparse prices and declared conversion assumptions; not observed dietary intake

underlying_prices_and_conversion_assumpt.source: Description of Potosi, 1603, discussed in footnote 52; Bakewell's conversion assumptions in footnote 53

prices.currency_reading: Presented within the same price discussion; do not silently substitute pesos corrientes.

underlying_prices_and_conversion_assumpt.limits: Historical units and modern food-composition analogies are the author's assumptions. Do not rebuild exact underlying prices from rounded printed mass/energy tables.

context_capoche_mid_1580s.refinery_coca: Additional coca in some cases; quantity not supplied here.
context_capoche_mid_1580s.ore_rights: Possible additional ore, not priced here.

context_about_1600.ore_rights: Extra compensation in ore for either type; one observer suggested value comparable to cash wage. Not a uniform measured ratio.
context_about_1600.preserve_employment_selection: Range depends on skill; access to such work is not universal.

currency_examples.basis: Explicit paired amounts: 24 reales (3 pesos); 56-72 reales (7-9 pesos); 20 reales (2.5 pesos).
currency_examples.scope: Ordinary peso/reales pairing in these wage passages; distinct from peso ensayado conversions.

not_a_result: No experiment 2b outcome, parameter sweep, break-even price or verdict has been computed for this transcription.
